newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct-Dec machinery orders seen up about 19.3%.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct-Dec machinery orders seen up about 19.3%.

text.p: Japan's private machinery orders, excluding those for machinery at electric power firms and for ships, in the October-December period is likely to show a quarter-on-quarter increase close to an earlier EPA projection of 19.3 percent, an Economic Planning Agency official told reporters on Tuesday.

The EPA on Tuesday announced that private machinery orders rose 44.2 percent in October from September. "The October figure was higher than what reality shows due to some special factors," the official said.
"Machinery orders are gradually increasing," the official said, adding the agency will consider dropping the word "gradually" after it sees the machinery orders for November.

"Machinery orders in November are likely to drop from October in reaction to the strong October figure. But if they drop less than 10 percent, we can say private orders are on a rising trend," he said.
